meaning:
Ἀδάμ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָדָם),
Adam: Luk.3:38, Rom.5:14, 1Co.15:22,45, 1Ti.2:13,14 Ju 14. Christ ὁ ἔσχατος Ἀ., 1Co.15:45.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: which was the son of Adam

elsewhere.note: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
